skills.name: agent-creator
skills.description: Create a Claude Code sub-agent definition for this project or user. Use when the user asks to create a new custom agent or a specialized sub-agent for a recurring task.
skills.description_zh: 为项目或用户创建 Claude Code 自定义子代理定义，适用于重复任务的专门代理。

skills.name: auto-dev
skills.description: Automated development pipeline. Runs a completed plan file through Development and Validation phases end-to-end.
headings: Step 0: 계획 확인 + 추적 초기화 [건너뛰기 금지]
Step 3: Validation Tasks 생성 및 실행
경로는 skills/plan-task/references/task-tools-fallback.md 의 플러그인 루트 해석을 따른다
skills.description_zh: 将已完成的计划文件端到端推进经过开发和验证阶段。

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Design and spec a Large new feature or system change before planning - explores requirements, proposes approaches, gets design approval, then chains to plan-task. Skip for bug fixes and Small/Medium work; go straight to plan-task or just do it.
skills.description_zh: 在大型新功能或系统变更规划前探索需求、提出方案、取得设计批准并转到 plan-task；缺陷及中小工作可跳过。

skills.name: child-session
skills.description: Discipline a worker session loads at dispatch time — verify the brief's premises before implementing, work only on its own branch, and report in the fixed completion format. Use when a session has been dispatched as a worker (child) with a brief from a parent control session.
headings: 6. 테스트 결과는 종료코드가 살아 있는 채로
파리티 — 차단 훅이 없는 하네스에서는 지침일 뿐이다
skills.description_zh: 规定被父会话分派的子工作者纪律：实现前核验简报前提，只在自身分支工作并按固定完成格式报告。

skills.name: control-loop
skills.description: Multi-session control discipline for delegating work to worker sessions — investigate, decide, dispatch, verify, and merge. Use when a session is coordinating separate worker sessions or worktrees and needs to know when to delegate versus decide, and how to verify before merging.
headings: 조사를 위임하지 않는 쪽으로 끌리는 힘이 있다 — 알고 저항한다
게이트 — 병합 전에 컨트롤이 직접 실행한다
응답 직전 — 자식 목록을 실제로 조회한다
skills.description_zh: 为跨会话或工作树委派提供调查、决策、分派、验证与合并流程，判断何时委派及如何合并前核验。

skills.name: cross-engine-review
skills.description: Reach an evidence-backed decision between sessions running on different agent engines. Use when a call is high-stakes enough that one engine's blind spots are a real risk, and a second session with different tool access can bring evidence the first cannot.
headings: cross-engine-review: 다른 엔진의 세션과 증거로 합의한다
언제 이것을 쓰고, 언제 multi-perspective-review 를 쓰나
합의 기준 (번호를 붙인다 — 라운드 중 이 번호로 참조한다)
3단계: 답신 형식 — 출처 마커 + 증거 등급
실행 주체 (답신 머리 — 값 한 줄 + 출처 한 줄, 필수)
skills.description_zh: 让不同代理引擎会话结合各自工具证据共同作出高风险决策，降低单引擎盲点影响。

skills.name: debug
skills.description: Analyze errors and apply fixes. Use when you have an error message, traceback, or failing log to diagnose.
headings: 위임 수단이 없는 하네스 — 강등 경로
skills.description_zh: 根据错误消息、回溯或失败日志诊断并应用修复。

skills.name: harness-export
skills.description: Export the kit's host-neutral rules to every harness entrypoint file (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md) so non-Claude-Code harnesses (Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Pi, Hermes) follow the same discipline. Use when a repo is worked by more than one agent harness, or after changing rules/. Trigger with /harness-export.
headings: Harness Export — 규범을 하네스 중립으로 내보내기
API 성 호출 레인 — 파일이 개념적으로 없다
1) 구현 위치 해석 — 변수가 비면 캐시에서 찾는다
4) 규범 블록을 표준출력으로 — **API 성 호출 레인의 유일한 경로**
이 킷 레포에서만 — 개발용 래퍼 (소비자 프로젝트에는 없다)
skills.description_zh: 把与宿主无关的规则导出到 AGENTS.md、GEMINI.md 等入口，让 Codex、OpenCode、Copilot、Gemini CLI、Pi、Hermes 等使用相同纪律；适用于多 harness 仓库或 rules 变更后。

skills.name: multi-perspective-review
skills.description: Multi-perspective review of a plan or design document. Up to ten viewpoints deliberate in 3 rounds; the main session orchestrates, with a sequential path for harnesses without subagents.
headings: A. 서브에이전트가 있는 하네스 (예: Claude Code)
B. 서브에이전트가 없는 하네스 (예: Codex) — 순차 경로
skills.description_zh: 从最多十个视角进行三轮计划或设计审查，由主会话协调，无子代理的 harness 可顺序执行。

skills.name: plan-task
skills.description: Structured task planning into a plan file. Use for any new feature, bug fix, or project that needs a task breakdown before implementation.
skills.description_zh: 为新功能、缺陷或项目在实施前分解任务并写入结构化计划文件。

skills.name: review
skills.description: Review current changes or specified files - ruff lint for Python files, an adversarial review-code pass, and a security scan only when security-sensitive files changed.
headings: git diff 대상 시 (변경된 .py 파일 추출 후)
0.5단계: 복잡도 flag — 하이브리드 (advisory 전용, Python 파일 포함 시)
mccabe 복잡도 flag (ruff 내장, 기본 임계 10)
skills.description_zh: 审查当前修改或指定文件，Python 用 ruff，开展对抗代码审查，仅安全敏感文件变化时运行安全扫描。

skills.name: skill-forge
skills.description: Distill a hard problem you just solved into a reusable skill draft - proposal-only, behind a three-condition threshold. Use after finishing a non-trivial task whose procedure would otherwise die with the session. Trigger with /skill-forge.
headings: Skill Forge — 성공 경험을 재사용 자산으로
skills.description_zh: 在完成复杂任务后将可复用难题流程提炼为技能草案，需满足三项门槛且只提出建议。

skills.name: test
skills.description: Run tests and auto-fix failures. Detects the test framework, executes tests, and iterates on fixes until all pass.
headings: 1단계: 프로젝트 타입 감지 및 테스트 실행
위임 수단이 없는 하네스 — 강등 경로
skills.description_zh: 识别测试框架、运行测试并迭代修复直到全部通过。

skills.name: using-hiway-kit
skills.description: Session-start meta-skill (hook-injected). Kit workflow chain and plan file rules.
skills.description_zh: 作为钩子注入的会话入口介绍 Hiway Kit 工作流链和计划文件规则。

skills.name: web-research
skills.description: Multi-source external research with cited sources, using search/docs MCP servers when installed and built-in web tools otherwise. Use when a question needs several external sources compared or synthesized, or a web task needs the user's logged-in browser. Not for a single quick lookup.
skills.description_zh: 比较综合多个外部来源并引用出处，优先已安装搜索/文档 MCP，否则内置网页工具，也支持需用户登录浏览器的研究；不用于单次快速查询。

headings: 자식 세션 판별 — 마커 파일, 그리고 그 한계
이 훅이 보지 못하는 것 (정직한 한계)
검증기 이름을 못 알아보는 경우 (직접 추가해야 한다)
근거 (실측 n=2, 서로 독립, 같은 날 다른 두 세션)
